description:
A blazingly fast, lightweight image viewer for Windows powered by Direct2D and SIMD.

QuickView is a high-performance image viewer for Windows, built with Direct2D hardware acceleration
and Google Highway SIMD optimization. It supports 80+ image formats including JPEG XL, AVIF, HEIC,
WebP, and RAW files. Features include HDR display support, portable mode, and GPU-accelerated rendering.
QuickView v6.57.14.2 Stable Release Notes
We are excited to announce QuickView v6.57.14.2 Stable!
This maintenance release focuses on resolving several important bugs across 16-bit HDR PNG & Gain Map rendering, window & taskbar lifecycle, Compare Mode, and hotkey / gesture ergonomics.
🎉 Now Officially Available on the Microsoft Store
Starting with this release, QuickView is officially live on the Microsoft Store!
The Store edition is distributed with an official Microsoft Store signature certificate, resolving Windows Defender and SmartScreen interception warnings on unsigned executables while providing seamless automatic updates.
Get it from Microsoft
How to Install
- Microsoft Store (Recommended): Click the badge above or visit Microsoft Store — QuickView (9N1D85F032CC) and click Install / Get, or run:
  winget install 9N1D85F032CC
- Portable Mode: Download QuickView_v6.57.14.2_*.zip below, extract anywhere, and run QuickView.exe.
- Standard Installer / WinGet: Download QuickView_Installer_v6.57.14.2_*.exe below, or run winget install justnullname.QuickView.
🐛 Important Bug Fixes
- [#266, #293] 16-bit HDR PNG, Gain Map & Color Pipeline Fixes: Fixed 16-bit HDR PNG decoding via Wuffs (BGRA_NONPREMUL_4X16LE + Highway SIMD swizzle) and cICP / ICC cicp / cLLi / mDCv metadata parsing; resolved D3D11 null constant-buffer unbind crashes in ComposeGainMap and ExecuteFsr1Upscale; enforced FP16 scRGB buffer precision and calibrated BT.2390-10 / OKLab tone and gamut mapping.
- [#301, #289] Pure-ESC Dismissal & Close Shortcut Decoupling: Separated pure-ESC layered overlay/fullscreen/slideshow dismissal from direct window-close shortcuts (Ctrl+W, Alt+F4, etc.), preventing maximized windows from unintentionally restoring before closing.
- [#279] Maximized Window Work-Area Clamping: Clamped maximized client bounds strictly to the monitor work area to prevent taskbar overlap.
- [#144] Compare Mode Expansion & Animation Sync: Enabled Titan huge images, animated images, and WebView2 SVGs in Compare Mode with isolated Left/Primary state, independent per-pane animation playback, and high-resolution aspect-preserving SVG offscreen rasterization.
- [#144] Gallery Filmstrip & Auto-Hide Toolbar Polish: Fixed filmstrip hotkey dismissal, hover suppression, and freeze deadlock; eliminated bottom toolbar auto-hide lag, timer starvation, and 8px bottom-edge dead zones on maximized / cross-monitor windows.
- [#264, #275, #144] Taskbar Minimize Bounce & Explorer COM Sync: Added WindowMinimizeGuard to prevent activation bounce after taskbar minimize and deferred Explorer selection sync off WM_ACTIVATE to eliminate STA COM re-entrancy stalls.
- [#300] Hotkey & Mouse Gesture Conflict UX: Added deferred gesture conflict alerts, restored Wheel Mode 1 & 2 with binding-aware OSD feedback, unified the Trigger × Action compatibility matrix, and cleaned up multi-button drag state handling.
Full Changelog: v6.57.6.0...v6.57.14.2
